prompt: Turn the person in this portrait into the character below, keeping exactly the same pixel-art style, outline weight, shading, pose, framing, lighting and flat dark background, with the same large, clearly drawn eyes, strong brows and defined mouth: a towering young foundry brute of twenty-two, an adult, massively built, with huge sloping shoulders, a thick bull neck and a big blocky head: a heavy jutting brow, deep-set fierce eyes with thick dark upper-lid lines, bright irises and a single bright catchlight each, a broad flattened nose, a wide grim mouth. A shaven scalp with dark stubble. The near half of his jaw is a mass of glossy, ridged pink burn scar from chin to ear, held together by twists of black iron wire and a riveted iron strap along the jawline; the far half has dark stubble. Bare, soot-smeared shoulders and arms, a raised brand scar on his shoulder, the top of a scorched leather apron at the bottom of the frame. His huge fists are raised in front of his chest, both wrists locked in thick riveted iron cuffs with links of broken chain hanging from them. Head and shoulders, his whole body, shoulders and face turned three-quarters toward the right, looking right, his head filling most of the frame; large, clearly drawn eyes, strong dark brows, a large defined mouth, bold dark outlines. A plain, flat, empty dark background. Lighting: a soft, dim warm amber rim light from the right, its lamp far out of frame and never visible, gentle warm fill, deep warm brown shadows. A plain dark background with no lamp, lantern or light source in the frame.
